summary: ReturnRide full-stack test: 27/27 backend pytest cases PASS (auth incl. blocked→403, maps reverse/search/route, rides/match seeded results, full booking lifecycle with OTP visibility rules for passenger/driver/admin, 400 on direct in_progress, wrong-OTP with attempts-left message, correct-OTP transition, complete with fare+breakdown, pay cash, rate 5★, cancel requires reason, admin stats/logs, non-admin→403). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport (390x844): passenger login→home book-ride-cta→location-picker (confirm-pickup-button, landmark chips, confirm-drop-button, find-rides-button)→matches (book-{rideId})→ride/[id] shows all four otp-digit-0..3. Driver login→incoming accept-{id}→ride screen btn-en-route, btn-arrived, btn-start opens otp-input; wrong OTP shows 'Wrong OTP, 4 attempts left' toast; correct OTP progresses to btn-complete→trip-summary. Passenger trip-summary shows trip-total, pay-cash/upi/wallet/razorpay, pay-button, star rating + submit-rating; end-to-end cash payment + 5★ rating verified via UI ('Thanks for rating!').

ui_bugs.issue: Pickup address label remains 'Move the map to set your point' when Confirm pickup is tapped at the default center (no reverse-geocode fires until user drags the map). This is what gets persisted into booking.pickup.address and shown on driver/ride/summary screens. Not a functional blocker but poor UX.

issues: React Native web warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — RN 0.75+ deprecations, cosmetic only

action_items: (Optional UX) In app/location-picker.tsx: trigger reverse-geocode on initial mount for the default center OR block confirm-pickup-button until an address resolves, so booking.pickup.address is never 'Move the map to set your point'.
(Optional) Migrate deprecated RN props (shadow*, pointerEvents) to their new APIs to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is clean, modular, and correctly excludes ObjectId via oid_str; OTP secret is stored as bcrypt hash (otp_hash) and only the plaintext otp is returned to the passenger via serialize() OTP_VISIBLE_STATES gate — correctly hidden from driver/admin.
bookings.py VALID_TRANSITIONS + explicit 400 for direct in_progress via /status is well-implemented; complete_ride enforces 500m proximity guard with override_reason escape hatch — good.
auth.py uses DUMMY_HASH to prevent user-enumeration timing side-channel — solid pattern.
maps.py has graceful fallback to straight-line route when OSRM fails — good resilience.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly; all interactive elements have testID as required.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all specified testIDs and flows verified end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed passenger accounts via /api/auth/register (phones start with '7...'). One booking was driven through the full lifecycle to completion+paid+rated via UI (booking id 6ab53706b88b4cf6dcbeda99, ride id 6ab531c5f8558c2de59401b1) for the seeded driver Ramesh Patil (9000000001).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests use pytest-xdist loadscope (2 workers) — phone numbers must be unique across workers, use random suffix (already implemented via _fresh_phone). Passenger 8000000001 will typically have a completed booking from this run; if a fresh passenger is needed to book, register a new one to avoid the 409 'You already have an active booking' guard. The seeded route Shirwal→Wai always has >=1 active match ride.
